remarks: **Highest & Best by 4:30 PM Tuesday, January 14th**   This tastefully updated and spacious 3 BR home located in the convenient Wolfpit area of Norwalk has it all. Main level Living Room w/wood burning fireplace & surround sound system, Dining room, Large Family room w/French doors to patio and private fully fenced-in backyard, Eat-In-Kitchen w/breakfast bar, stainless appliances, Quartz countertops, Pantry & Laundry. 2 Bedrooms on Main level w/updated Full Bath complete the main level. Up to the 2nd floor where you will find the Primary Suite, full Bath w/frameless shower, and a walk-in closet the size of a small BR! This home has been lovingly maintained both inside & out: Trees pruned, house pressure washed, AC & Furnace, insect repellant system all serviced annually. New Dryer, stairway & Primary BR carpeting. 2 flat screen TV's (LR & Primary BR) will stay, along with the surround sound system located in the 1st floor mechanical closet & speakers throughout. An attached 1 car Garage w/work bench and a Landscape shed complete this property. Centrally located and minutes to shops, restaurants, train station(s), I-95 and Merritt Pwy. Audio and Video cameras in and outside of house.
